title: Items
summary: A company's goods and services: code (generated or typed), name, kind (goods or service, fixed), whether its stock is tracked (fixed; never for a service), category, a base unit (fixed) and alternative units with a fixed factor to it, barcode, and the optional Coretax goods/service code and unit code (format checked only) — deactivated, never deleted. Its own unit and category lists, with the common units one click away. Offers ItemCatalog (Get, Search, Usable inside a posting's d.Tx, Unit and Units for conversion to the base unit). Publishes its lifecycle as events (items.item.created/changed/deactivated/activated).
when_to_use: The app records goods or services: stock, purchasing, sales, a POS, price lists, invoices.
when_not_to_use: Stock on hand, warehouses, and valuation — the stock module, which reads items through its port.
Selling prices — a price-lists module; variants and images — a later items version.
The official Coretax code lists — a coretax kit; this module only checks the codes' format.
One item list shared by several companies — this module keeps each company's own.

permissions.name: items.manage
permissions.description: Menambah, mengubah, dan menonaktifkan barang, satuan, dan kategori

emits.name: items.item.created
emits.description: An item was added: {id, company_id, code, name, kind}.

emits.name: items.item.changed
emits.description: An item or one of its parts changed: {id, company_id, code, name, part} — part is "item" (its own fields: code, name, category, barcode…) or "unit" (an alternative unit added, activated again, or deactivated). Read the current state through the contract.

emits.name: items.item.deactivated
emits.description: An item was deactivated: {id, company_id, code, name}. New documents may not use it; its old ones stay.

emits.name: items.item.activated
emits.description: A deactivated item was activated again: {id, company_id, code, name}.
